claims.claim: The new pure Source Observation contract validates exact RA-1 Brief and Request bindings, closed fields, representation kinds, normalized opaque content, fixed UNTRUSTED trust, content SHA-256, and observation fingerprint.

Provenance validation enforces exact UTC timestamps, bounded locator or stable identity, ordered resolution chains, sorted unique version facts, and closed access scopes; it rejects malformed or credential-bearing provenance.

The Acquisition Attempt contract binds exact RA-1 identities, preserves observation order, accepts empty success, restricts failure to the closed operational taxonomy, and enforces observation count, byte, uniqueness, and binding rules.
Attribution is limited to closed bounded operational identity fields. Construction and revalidation invoke no source adapter or external I/O and create no lifecycle or persistence state.

Focused regressions cover public and private observations, normalization, opaque prompt-like text, representation and provenance rules, valid foreign bindings, empty success, failure codes, attribution, budgets, duplicates, and blocked I/O calls.
